newsitem.title: UK: Nationwide to wait and see on rate action.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide to wait and see on rate action.

text.p: The UK's Nationwide Building Society said on Tuesday it would wait and see whether interest rates rose across the market before deciding on whether to increase its own mortgage and savings rates.
"If interest rates rise generally across the market then we will reflect that," a Nationwide spokeswoman told Reuters.

Earlier the new Labour government increased interest rates to 6.25 percent from 6.0 percent, prompting the Halifax Building Society to increase its variable mortgage rate to 7.6 percent from 7.25 percent.
Nationwide, which is one of the UK's largest building societies, said its standard variable mortgage rate would retain its competitive position. The rate is currently 6.99 percent.
The spokeswoman said the building society, which is retaining its mutual ownership while others seek stock exchange listings and bank status, would also remain competitive on savings.
